title: ID0452874-DC/Si-D/BE-[Mutli] RFID LED Issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: RFID LED Issue
Solution:
Yes, this is expected behavior after the last firmware update. The LED will remain on, and this does not indicate any issue with the device.
Worked By: Younes Baroudi

additional_info.subject: ID0452874-DC/Si-D/BE-[Mutli] RFID LED Issue CRM:03055000032
additional_info.body:
Dear Chloë
Apologies for the confusion in my previous reply.
To clarify: yes, this is expected behavior after the latest firmware update. The LED will now remain on at all times, which is normal operation with the new version. This change has been implemented to reduce customer interaction with the screen. When a customer wants to charge using RFID, they can simply pass their RFID card over the reader without needing to click on the HMI. No further action is required.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
